svg.title: S4 — Upstream dependency, certificate or DNS expiry (vendor fault)
svg.desc: Tests ‘ours or theirs’ and the not_actionable verdict. AWS us-east-1 Oct-2025 (50 min to root cause), Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 Jul-2025 (9-min detection gap, BGP hijack red herring), Google Voice 2021 cert (only NEW connections failed).
svg.text: S4 — Upstream dependency, certificate or DNS expiry (vendor fault)

Tests ‘ours or theirs’ and the not_actionable verdict. AWS us-east-1 Oct-2025 (50 min to root cause), Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 Jul-2025 (9-min detection gap, BGP hijack red herring), Google Voice 2021 cert (only NEW connections failed).
or nothing — vendor change is invisible
cert expires · DNS removed · prefix withdrawn
(AWS: DNS Enactor race removed all IPs)
keep-alives survive → errors RAMP, not step
all callers of that host fail at once
H4 our own deploy (S2) · H5 vendor rate limit
errors from all AZs, not one (E5)
red herring named: BGP hijack / DDoS
did anything of ours change? no (E1)
nothing to fix here; mitigate impact only
1 fail open: flag off dependent feature
3 renew cert if OURS (Epic 37 min) — n/a
vendor still down — impact mitigated only

Discriminating queries: dig +short host @1.1.1.1 / @8.8.8.8 · openssl s_client … | x509 -noout -dates · curl -sv from ≥2 regions ‖ PromQL: probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry − time() · probe_success · sum by(host)(rate(http_client_requests{status=~"5..|0"})) · dns_lookup_failures ‖ logs: x509|certificate has expired|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN ‖ change events: confirm ZERO.

Grounding: AWS us-east-1 2025-10-19 DynamoDB DNS — 23:48 onset · 00:38 root cause · 02:25 DNS restored (READ) · Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 2025-07-14 — 21:48 withdraw · 22:01 alert · 22:20 revert · 22:54 restored; BGP hijack unrelated (READ) · Google Voice 2021 cert 4 h 22 min, new SIP only (READ via report) · Epic 2021 wildcard cert 37 min (INFERRED) · incident.io 2025-10-20 hit via transitive vendors (READ via summary).

Why it matters to Smokejumper: this is the only scenario whose correct verdict is NOT root_caused — `not_actionable` must exist in B6 (it does not today; see reference-architecture-analysis §4). The unit of failure is the transitive dependency, not the named vendor.
